posts.subject: Addition to the !rules
posts.bodyHtml:
Hello to the Dream community! =)


If I recall correctly, (maybe just on 35hp_knife) but users are only allowed to talk in German/English in the voice chat, right? If so, I believe this should be added to !rules to make sure that not only newcomers know this, but to clear any future arguments about what language is allowed in the voice chat.


For example, I just had a brief argument with a few players speaking in French but I couldn't make them stop as there is no concrete proof that you're not allowed. Thus, adding this rule to !rules would be good :'D


Thank you!
~ Doo Doo

You are right, for some reason, that rule is missing from the Knife rules ([KNIFE] 23.10.15) but is present on other servers like Minigame ([MINIGAME] 23.10.15).


I will edit the Knife rules shortly and add the rule since it's present on other servers and is enforced by admins as well.

The rules are edited now and I've added that rule. Also, I've clarifed the backstabbing issue and added a new "rule" for that since players either don't know about it or are simply misunderstanding it.


I'm referring to:
[KNIFE] 23.10.15

Zitat von BlackFire

NEW: Backstabbing is allowed but not in a 2vs1 (not allowed if the player is fighting with another player)

Also, I'm wondering if you can somehow make the rules more apparent to new comers as they simply ignore the screen. Maybe you could create a popup when new players come in and see the basic rules (no camping, 2vs1, disrespecting members and admins)


I just thought of this as many new players simply don't know the rules and ignore the starting screen.

Zitat von Doo Doo

Maybe you could create a popup when new players come in and see the basic rules (no camping, 2vs1, disrespecting members and admins)


I just thought of this as many new players (...)ignore the starting screen.

What kind of popup are you talking about? Isn't there a chance of them clicking it away without reading it as well?
I know this post is kinda old but if there is a Polish player (example) and he does not know any of the languages English nor German there for I have right to explain to him in voice chat.

Hey Oxygen,


Could you not simply just add him on steam and talk to him via steam chat? The main reason that the rule is German/English only is that so most people can understand each other. I usually allow people to talk in their preferred language if there are little people but since the increase of players on the knife server, there are usually 15+ people on the server most of the time and therefore, it causes confusion between the people if you're speaking in a less, populated language in the server.



~ Doo Doo
it's easier and faster to use voice chat.
